change.title: pr-5
change.description: adding flexbox to header via mixins (all prefixes)
change.author: awesomerobot

findings.title: small-action flex layout leaves the delete/edit buttons no longer at the right edge
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex row, but `.small-action-desc` has no `flex: 1`, so it shrinks to its content width. The delete/edit `<button>`s are children of `.small-action-desc` (templates/components/small-action.hbs:5-9) and rely on `float: right` (line 309) to reach the right edge. The float now only moves them to the right edge of the shrunken desc box. For a short description they sit right after the text instead of at the far right of the 755px row (desktop/topic-post.scss:730-733). Add `flex: 1` to `.small-action-desc`, or `margin-left: auto` on the buttons. I could not run it, so this comes from reading the CSS.

findings.title: Removing the 4em left padding breaks the mobile `.custom-message` -40px offset
findings.body: mobile/topic-post.scss:520-522 sets `.small-action .small-action-desc .custom-message { margin-left: -40px }`. It compensated for the old `padding-left: 4em` on `.small-action-desc`. The desc padding is now `0 1.5%` and the desc is a flex item next to the 45px-wide `.topic-avatar` icon (line 274). A -40px margin therefore pulls the custom message text left over the icon, because flex items do not wrap around siblings the way line boxes wrap around floats. The mobile `p { padding-top: 0 }` override (mobile/topic-post.scss:517-519) is also redundant now that the base `padding-top: 4px` is gone. Remove or adjust both mobile overrides in this PR.

findings.title: align-items mixin emits an invalid property and values the 2009 box syntax rejects
findings.body: `-ms-align-items` is not a real property (IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align`, already on line 120). `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align` only accept `start|end|center|baseline|stretch`, so passing `flex-start` or `flex-end` would be dropped in those legacy syntaxes. Current callers only pass `center` and `baseline`, which are fine. Drop `-ms-align-items`, and strip the trailing whitespace on line 120. The repo has no autoprefixer (no match in Gemfile or config), so hand-written prefixes are the convention here.

findings.title: Leftover floats are no-ops, and the PR is wider than its description
findings.body: `float: left` on `.topic-avatar` (line 270) and `float: right` on `button` (line 309) have no effect inside a flex container, apart from the button case described above. The PR body says only 'adding flexbox to header via mixins', but the change also converts `.small-action` (topic posts and time-gaps), changes `.badge-wrapper.bullet`, and removes the `.extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper.bullet` margin. Those surfaces need their own visual check.

contracts.action: Header `.contents` becomes a flex row; `.title` loses float; `.panel` loses float and gets margin-left:auto with order 3; `.extra-info-wrapper` gets order 2
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous float layout: .title float left, .panel float right, extra-info-wrapper as an overflow:hidden block filling the gap (desktop/topic-post.scss:518-539)
contracts.before_after: Before: floats plus a block that fills the remaining width. After: flex items in DOM order logo, panel, extra-info, reordered visually to logo, extra-info, panel. The .clearfix pseudo-elements on .contents become empty flex items, which is harmless. The overflow:hidden extra-info item can still shrink for ellipsis.
contracts.visible_effect: The header looks the same, with the user icons pinned to the right and the docked topic title between the logo and the icons. Mixins are imported before base/* (common.scss:6-12), so compilation is fine.
contracts.failure_mode: Old browsers without flex fall back to the prefixed syntaxes. No JS or async involved.

contracts.action: `.small-action` becomes a flex container with centered items; desc padding changes
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous block layout with a floated avatar icon and a desc box padded 4em on the left
contracts.before_after: Before: the desc box was full width, so its floated buttons reached the right edge. After: the desc is a shrink-to-fit flex item, and the mobile override `.custom-message { margin-left:-40px }` is still applied (mobile/topic-post.scss:516-523).
contracts.visible_effect: The edit/delete buttons move next to the text, and the mobile custom message may overlap the icon.

summary: Review of the five stylesheet files, from reading the CSS only (nothing was built or run). Mixins are imported before use and the header flex conversion looks sound. Two likely visual regressions come from converting `.small-action` to flex. The edit/delete buttons lose their right-edge position, and the mobile `.custom-message` -40px margin now overlaps the icon. The `align-items` mixin also emits an invalid `-ms-align-items`. The PR body mentions only the header, but the change also touches small actions and badges.
